text:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: inference-api -> release-2026-03-15-b (5% traffic) ...

maria: saw increased 503s from a few customers hitting inference-api, starting ~10:13 UTC. Can everyone confirm? :eyes:

lee: I see p95 latency spike and 502s in the canary pods, logs show image pull warnings and occasional checksum mismatch.

chris: tagging in — checking CI artifacts. infra-jenkins: the pipeline shows the image push to registry succeeded, but two different tags point to same mutable tag 'release-2026-03-15-b-latest'

maria: ugh, could be a tag-reuse issue from the CI cache layer. Are we still using mutable tags for canaries? :thinking_face:

lee: Looks like a race — the build was rebuilt and the tag reused before digest propagated to the other region. Some nodes pulled older layers -> manifest mismatch.

oncall-bot: @maria you were paged for INC-2026-045 - inference-api degraded (customer errors)

maria: I'm on it. Initiating mitigation checklist.

chris: immediate mitigation: stop traffic to canary. Run:
```
kubectl patch svc inference-api -n prod -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"canary":"false"}}}'
``` 
(or flip traffic split in traffic-controller)

maria: flipped traffic, canary at 0%. Observed error rate dropping in <2m. Good.

lee: recommend cutting the rollout and triggering feature-flag kill-switch for the new ranking pipeline to prevent flaky responses. LD flag: inference_canary_enabled -> false

maria: flag flipped via internal flags UI. Noted customer impact: approx 1.2% of active requests errored during 10:13-10:16 UTC; customers in EU region most affected.

chris: while traffic is down, we need to investigate artifact immutability. infra-jenkins: can you confirm registry settings and whether tag immutability is enabled on the repo?

infra-jenkins: registry shows mutable tags allowed on repo prod-images/inference-api. We have two pushes within 90s that used same tag; digest changed. That's the root cause.

lee: plan: mark current tag as deprecated, rebuild with a stable semantic tag containing commit hash, enable immutability on the repo, and re-deploy verified digest.

chris: also purge any stale local caches on nodes that pulled the incorrect manifest: cordon, drain one affected node and restart kubelet to force image re-pull.

maria: executing node drains now on the three nodes that showed failing pulls. Rolling restarts of kubelet in progress.

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder — @chris you're next on-call in 25 minutes. Please ack.

chris: ack. I'll follow-up on postmortem and customer communication.

lee: rebuild started with new tag format release-2026-03-15-b+sha256:ab12cd. CI will push immutable manifest.

infra-jenkins: pushed immutable image. Digest: sha256:ff3344... verified across regions.

maria: redeploying canary with immutable image and 1% traffic to smoke test.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed: inference-api -> release-2026-03-15-b+sha256:ab12cd (1% traffic)

maria: monitoring — no 502/503s in the last 5 minutes, p95 latency stable.

lee: enabling small ramp for 10% if stable for 10m. Also filing infra ticket to enable registry immutability and CI guardrails to fail if tag reused.

chris: customers affected: mapped to 3 accounts; outreach queued to CSMs with incident summary and mitigation steps.

maria: summary for postmortem: root cause = mutable registry tags + CI race reusing tag, propagated mismatch across regions; mitigation = cut canary traffic, feature-flag kill-switch, redeploy immutable image, node cache purge; next actions = enable immutability, CI guards, rollout playbook update.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 resolved (status: mitigated). Please add notes to incident log.

maria: adding notes now. Thank you all — follow-up doc & postmortem will be created in #incidents. :white_check_mark:
